name: Shinkin Central Bank
summary: Shinkin Central Bank operates as a central bank for Shinkin banks in Japan. The company provides various products and services, such as deposits, bonds, lending, market, settlement, trading operations, and trust services, as well as credit union operations. It is also involved in securities operations, regional trading company operations, overseas business support operations, consumer credit guarantee operations, and investment management operations, as well as M&A brokerage and data processing outsourcing. The company serves small and medium enterprises, individuals, and local communities. Shinkin Central Bank was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
